panels.title: Trades per cooperative
panels.description: Created-trade rate by cooperative (backend/src/lib/metrics.ts: amana_cooperative_trades_total{event="created"}). Attributed on the bulk-import path when the caller belongs to the labelled cooperative — see ADR-009.

panels.title: GMV per region (USDC/hour)
panels.description: Gross merchandise value per region, derived from the amana_cooperative_gmv_usdc_cents histogram sum (backend/src/lib/metrics.ts), converted from USDC cents to USDC.

panels.title: Dispute rate per cooperative
panels.description: Share of created pilot trades that became disputed, by cooperative. Uses the same per-cooperative funnel counter as panel 1; compare against the global dispute-rate alert (amana_dispute_rate_anomalies_total).

panels.title: Bulk import rows by outcome
panels.description: Row-level outcomes of POST /trades/bulk batches (backend/src/lib/metrics.ts: amana_bulk_import_total). A rising failed share means the import CSV (or the importer's wallet funding) needs attention, not the trade pipeline.
